description: Every complaint must carry a complaint_id; without it a record cannot be traced or de-duplicated.
CFPB complaint IDs are numeric; a value containing any non-digit suggests corruption or a column shift.
Each complaint_id should appear once. Counts the surplus records (2nd, 3rd... occurrence) of an ID that repeats.
Every complaint must name the company it concerns; reporting by company is impossible otherwise.

date_received must be a real calendar date; ingestion has already converted real ISO timestamps (e.g. 2024-12-23T11:23:45.000Z) and MM/DD/YYYY or MM/DD/YY dates to YYYY-MM-DD, so anything else is invalid (rejects blanks, 2024-13-45, 2024-02-30, 05-Dec-2024).
A valid date_received should fall between the earliest CFPB date (:min_date) and today (:today). Invalid dates are handled by DQ-005.

rule_name: Missing or invalid date sent to company
description: date_sent_to_company is expected on every record and must be a real calendar date (real ISO timestamps and MM/DD/YYYY or MM/DD/YY values are converted to YYYY-MM-DD at ingestion; blanks and anything unrecognisable fail).

rule_name: Date sent to company earlier than date received
description: A complaint cannot be sent to the company before it was received. Only records where BOTH dates are valid are compared.
A non-blank state must be a recognised 2-letter US state, DC, territory or military code (data/reference/us_states.csv). Blank states are handled separately by DQ-010.
explanation: 178 of 99,350 records (0.18%) fail this check. A non-blank state must be a recognised 2-letter US state, DC, territory or military code (data/reference/us_states.csv). Blank states are handled separately by DQ-010. Exceeds the allowed 0%.

description: State is optional (consumers may not provide it or may be outside the US) so some blanks are legitimate; the rule fails only if more than 5% of records have no state.
Product is the primary reporting dimension and is mandatory.
Issue (what the complaint is about) is mandatory for reporting.
submitted_via (Web, Phone, ...) is mandatory.
company_response_to_consumer is mandatory in the public database.
timely_response is mandatory; without it the timely-response percentage cannot be calculated accurately.
The same product written with different case or spacing (e.g. 'Mortgage' vs 'mortgage') splits reports into false categories.
The same issue written with different case or spacing fragments issue-level reporting.
The same company written with different case or spacing splits its complaint count across several names.
explanation: 8 of 99,350 records (0.01%) fail this check. The same company written with different case or spacing splits its complaint count across several names. Exceeds the allowed 0%.

rule_name: Leading or trailing spaces in key text fields
description: Product, issue or company values padded with spaces compare as different from the clean value in SQL. Blank (spaces-only) values are excluded - they are covered by the missing-value rules.
submitted_via must be one of the allowed channels listed in ref_valid_values.
company_response_to_consumer must be one of the allowed response types listed in ref_valid_values.
timely_response must be exactly Yes or No.
consumer_disputed is optional (no longer collected for new complaints) but a non-blank value must be Yes, No or N/A.
